use_case_name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

claims.content: The objective is to transmit air and surface tracks after achieving Active status or returning to it from Inactive status/TDS Failure.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The objective is to transmit air and surface tracks after achieving Active status or returning to it from Inactive status/TDS Failure.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: C2 JU has an air or surface surveillance track in Active status (including one restored from Inactive status or TDS Failure) and publishes that track.
scope_contract.start_boundary: C2 JU has an air or surface surveillance track that has achieved Active status or has just returned to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
scope_contract.success_boundary: C2 JU has transmitted/published the air or surface surveillance track.
in_scope_actions: Publishing/transmitting air and surface surveillance tracks after Active status is achieved or restored from Inactive status or TDS Failure
excluded_adjacent_actions: Performing common tracking in accordance with correlation and decorrelation procedures (EC-G-000)
Recognizing and resolving dual track designations (EC-G-003)
Providing automatic decorrelation capability for initiated real-time tracks (EC-G-006)
Recognizing and resolving information differences in air, surface, and land surveillance exchange (EC-G-007)
variant_dimensions: Track domain (air vs surface) when a single publishing instance handles only one category

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has initially achieved Active status, or has returned to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
Sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration have been performed.

The C2 JU has assumed R² for the track in accordance with an applicable reporting rule (e.g., it has correlated local sensor data; it has not received a remote report on the locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds; or, following a J2 PPLI message indicating Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure from the unit with R², local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received on that track).
The C2 JU initially achieves Active status, or returns to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
The C2 JU applies the 12-second minimum wait before reporting the air or surface track.
The C2 JU determines the type of surveillance message to use based on the Environment/Category of the unit being reported.

For the previously-reported track for which the C2 JU is assuming R², the C2 JU accepts all defined values for the implemented Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields for retransmission and operator appreciation.

The C2 JU retransmits those accepted values unless it holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) for a field and that locally derived data differs from the accepted value; in that case, it reports the locally derived data.
Non-No Statement Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type data received from the controlling unit for the track is retransmitted regardless of any locally derived data.
The C2 JU reports the Track Number, Platform, and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages, with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator reported as value 1.

The C2 JU determines IFF/SIF code validity for established tracks as either 'Valid Data' or 'No Data', reporting 'No Data' as zeroes in the applicable Mode Code field and 'Valid Data' as the nonzero code after meeting the applicable interrogation thresholds (two successive for Modes I/II/III, one for Mode IV, or manual entry).

The C2 JU reports the air/surface track for which it has assumed R² as a track/point on the Surveillance Network PG, reporting all IFF/SIF valid data locally held for that track in accordance with the transmit rules for the J3 messages.

Diverges from Step 1: instead of applying the 12-second minimum wait before reporting, operational necessity may require a shorter wait time or none at all, and the system design permits an override of the wait.
Diverges from Step 4: if the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, the JU assuming R² retransmits it as value 1, overriding any other potential value handling.

Diverges from Step 6: if position or other data in a PPLI meet decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data are decorrelated and the C2 JU initiates a surveillance track report using locally held data with a new track number, reporting the PPLI Track Number, Identity Indicator, and IFF/SIF Indicator fields as No Statement rather than reporting the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator as value 1.

Diverges from main-flow Step 3: when accepting Platform, Platform Activity, or Specific Type values for retransmission, if a received value is 0 (No Statement) and a non-zero value is held locally, the C2 JU does not retain the received No Statement value for retransmission.

Diverges from main-flow Step 3: if an Air Platform value of 6 (Tanker), 7 (Tanker Boom Only), or 8 (Tanker Drogue Only) is held locally and a different Air Platform value is received, the received value is not retained for retransmission (exception to the normal retention rule); an operator alert is optional.

Diverges from main-flow Step 8: a track report is identified as a nonreal-time report with the TQ field set to 0 if (a) the track data originate from other than a TDS or JTIDS/MIDS equipped aircraft, (b) the track data have been relayed from another system by other than a real-time data link interface, or (c) the track data have been derived from other than integrated sensors.

Diverges from main-flow Step 8: if the C2 JU receives a remote track report for the real-time air/surface track in which remote TQ is greater than local TQ, or remote TQ equals local TQ and the remote JU's Source TN (STN) is greater than local Source TN (STN), the C2 JU relinquishes R² for the track.

Diverges from main-flow Step 8: if tracks are automatically purged after a specific time interval (considering irregular reporting of nonreal-time tracks), a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall not be transmitted.

missing_aspects: Explicit continuation after R² relinquishment is not documented.
Explicit alternative action after J7.0 purge suppression is not documented.

claims.content: After successfully publishing a track for which the C2 JU has assumed R², the track is reported as a track/point on the Surveillance Network PG with Identity reported as Friend; the Track Number, Platform, and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages are retransmitted, and the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator are reported as value 1 and maintained if another C2 JU later assumes R² of the IU.

After successful publication, values accepted for retransmission are reported, unless the C2 JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement for the field that differ from the accepted value; in that case, the locally derived data are reported.

After successful publication of a track report for which the C2 JU has assumed R², the C2 JU retains R² for that track until it is relinquished in accordance with the applicable R² rules (e.g., reception of a remote report with higher TQ, or equal TQ and greater Source TN) or until the track is dropped.

In the decorrelation alternative, the successful post-decorrelation state includes initiation of a new surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number, and reporting of the PPLI Track Number, Identity Indicator field, and PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field as 'No Statement'.

missing_aspects: complete description of system state after successful track publication or decorrelation
complete description of system state after successful track publication
